title: The threshold is a business decision, not the default 0.5

videos.script: Every library draws its line at one half. {{half}} Feira em Casa's credit pays for itself at a little over a quarter. {{quarter}} So the default throws away more than half the money the model could make. {{default}} This lesson is about where the line should go instead, and who gets to say. {{who}} First, whether the model's chances mean what they say. Here they run low. {{low}} The reason is not the model. Prices rose in September, and more people left. {{rise}} Then calibration, which repairs a model that distorts, and cannot repair a world that moved. {{calibration}} Then a team that can only make a hundred and fifty calls a month. {{calls}} And a guess in the business's numbers that matters more than any model. {{guess}} By the end, you can defend a cut to four people who each want a different one. {{end}}
